findings.title: Potential SQL injection in review search endpoint
findings.description: An unsanitized query parameter is concatenated into a SQL statement.
findings.reason: An attacker-controlled search term reaches the database query builder without parameterization.
findings.suggestion: Switch to parameterized queries and validate accepted search fields.

findings.title: File path input should be constrained
findings.description: A repository path value is used without strong normalization.
findings.reason: Path traversal may be possible if user input is not normalized and restricted.
findings.suggestion: Resolve against a trusted root and reject path segments that escape the workspace.
